rationale: Both find the period-6 pattern of Fibonacci numbers mod 4 and use 100 ≡ 4 (mod 6) to get remainder 3. A simply asserts that the pattern repeats every 6 terms after listing values. B computes each term from the recurrence and explains why the pattern must repeat: the pair (F7,F8) returns to (1,1), the same as (F1,F2), so the whole sequence cycles. That justification is the key logical step, and only B supplies it.
